quests.name: Conscript of the Horde
objectives: Deliver the recruitment letter to Kargal Battlescar at Far Watch Post (west road from Razor Ridge, cross the bridge into the Barrens).

quests.name: Crossroads Conscription
objectives: Take the Signed Recruitment Letter to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Plainstrider Menace
objectives: Collect 7 Plainstrider Beaks and return them to Sergra Darkthorn.

quests.name: The Zhevra
objectives: Collect 4 Zhevra Hooves from Zhevra Runner, Charger, Courser or Swiftmane.

quests.name: Raptor Thieves
objectives: Bring 12 Raptor Heads to Gazrog (Sunscale Lashtail, Screecher, Scytheclaw, Ishamuhale).

quests.name: Disrupt the Attacks
objectives: Kill 8 Razormane Water Seekers, 8 Razormane Thornweavers and 3 Razormane Hunters.

quests.name: The Disruption Ends
objectives: Kill 8 Razormane Geomancers, 8 Razormane Defenders and Kreenig Snarlsnout (Razormane camp, Kreenig around 58.5, 27).

quests.name: Supplies for the Crossroads
objectives: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork.

quests.name: The Barrens Oases
objectives: Speak with Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.

quests.name: The Forgotten Pools
objectives: Search the lake at the Forgotten Pools (northwest of the Crossroads) for the source of power, then report back to Tonga.

quests.name: The Stagnant Oasis
objectives: Test the Dried Seeds in a crevice at the southeastern Oasis of Dead Water, then return to Tonga.

quests.name: Altered Beings
objectives: Bring 8 Altered Snapjaw Shells (from Oasis Snapjaw) to Tonga Runetotem.

quests.name: Fungal Spores
objectives: Bring 4 Fungal Spores (from Laden Mushrooms) to Apothecary Helbrim.

quests.name: Centaur Bracers
objectives: Bring 15 Centaur Bracers (dropped by Kolkar centaurs) to Regthar Deathgate.

quests.name: Kolkar Leaders
objectives: Bring Kodobane's Head (Barak Kodobane) to Regthar Deathgate.

quests.name: Verog the Dervish
objectives: Kill centaurs at the camp near the Dead Water Oasis (southeast) until Verog appears, then bring Verog's Head to Regthar.

quests.name: Hezrul Bloodmark
objectives: Kill Hezrul Bloodmark (named centaur with adds) and bring Hezrul's Head to Regthar.

quests.name: Harpy Raiders
objectives: Collect 8 Witchwing Talons.

quests.name: Harpy Lieutenants
objectives: Collect 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings from Witchwing Slayers and return them to Darsok.

quests.name: Serena Bloodfeather
objectives: Slay Serena Bloodfeather and return her head to Darsok Swiftdagger (harpy boss, level 20 recommended).

quests.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
objectives: Bring the Secure Crate to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.

quests.name: Southsea Freebooters
objectives: Kill 12 Southsea Brigands and 6 Southsea Cannoneers.

quests.name: The Missing Shipment
objectives: Bring Gazlowe's Ledger to Wharfmaster Dizzywig.

quests.name: Stolen Booty
objectives: Collect a Shipment of Boots (Drizzlik's Emporium) and a Telescopic Lens (Fragile - Do Not Drop).

quests.name: WANTED: Baron Longshore
objectives: Bring Baron Longshore's Head to Gazlowe in Ratchet.

quests.name: Samophlange
objectives: Access the control console at the Venture Co. research site (northern pass, Sludge Fen area).

quests.name: Ignition Key
objectives: Get the Ignition Key (carried by Supervisor Lugwizzle, around 56.3, 8.6) and bring it to Wizzlecrank.

quests.name: Flee
objectives: Escort Wizzlecrank and the stolen goblin shredder to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.
quests.sourceNote: games.gg calls this chain step 'The Escape' (863).

quests.name: Raptor Horns
objectives: Collect 5 Intact Raptor Horns from Sunscale Scytheclaws, Ishamuhale or Takk the Leaper.

quests.name: Meats to Orgrimmar
objectives: Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak at the Crossroads (unlocks the Crossroads flight path ride).

quests.name: A Bundle of Hides
objectives: Bring the Bundle of Hides to Devrak at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Parts and Fragments
objectives: Collect 5 Handful of Complicated Parts from the upper pirate camp south of Ratchet.

quests.name: WANTED: Bruuz
objectives: Kill Bruuz in Ratchet harbour (around 63.7, 38.7) and deliver his dorsal fin to Gazlowe.

flightPaths.name: The Crossroads, The Barrens
flightPaths.note: Links to Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff.

notes: uiMapID NOT confirmed. 1413 (The Barrens), 1411 (Durotar) and 1454 (Orgrimmar) are Classic Era values supplied by the requester and kept as an assumption. Forever uses the retail 12.x API; retail values are Barrens 10, Durotar 1, Orgrimmar 85. Verify in game with C_Map.GetBestMapForUnit('player'). The forever-codex page says the Barrens keeps its Classic map with no new areas, which supports reuse of the same terrain coordinates.

Sources: Wowhead Forever zone page https://www.wowhead.com/forever/zone=17/the-barrens loaded with NO quest list (only dungeon links), so it could not be used. Quest data (level, minLevel, XP, NPC, coordinates, prereqs) comes from wowforever.wclbox.com quest pages (Forever database; each page says 'as far as we know, Forever leaves this quest unchanged', i.e. values equal Classic for those). Hub/innkeeper/flight data from games.gg, wowhandbook.com and forever-codex.com. forever-xp.com returned HTTP 403, foreverchanges.pro was not consulted. No RestedXP or paid sources used.

Quest count: 33 quests in this file (levels 10-20, Horde, northern/central Barrens and Ratchet). Forever-new with ids: 97253 Parts and Fragments (wclbox name; forever-codex and wowhandbook call it 'Parts and Pieces', level 14, Wrenix the Wretched 63.1, 36.3) and 92706 WANTED: Bruuz (level 20, min 15; forever-codex and wowhandbook spell it Bruuz, wclbox 'Bruz'). Both have no XP listed on wclbox. All others are classic quests, with Forever values as published on wclbox.

Undercity/Tirisfal to The Barrens travel path (Undead): 1) Zeppelin tower in Tirisfal Glades, between Brill and the Undercity gates, on the road east of Brill (warcraft.wiki.gg, games.gg, wowhandbook.com). EXACT COORDINATES NOT FOUND in any source; Hin Denburg (npc 3150) is the Orgrimmar-route zeppelin master there, and the western berth goes to Orgrimmar (Thundercaller). Take the Orgrimmar zeppelin, not the Grom'gol (Stranglethorn) one. Only one tower exists in Classic/Forever (a second was added in WotLK).

Durotar side of the zeppelin: the Durotar Zeppelin Tower is at 50.8, 13.4 on the Durotar map (mapId 1411), on the cliff east of Orgrimmar's main gate, berths to Undercity and Grom'gol (wowhandbook.com, 'Orgrimmar' page; the same page also says 'just outside the southern gate', so the page is internally inconsistent). Frezza (npc 9564) is the Orgrimmar-side zeppelin master per warcraft.wiki.gg; Wowhead lists his spawn in Durotar (2 spawns), not Orgrimmar. So in Classic/Forever the zeppelin lands in Durotar and the Orgrimmar flight master (Doras, 45.3, 63.8) is inside the city, a short walk west. Whether Forever moved the tower inside the city was NOT verified (post-Cataclysm retail tower is at 51.5, 54.3 inside Orgrimmar); verify in game.

Orgrimmar to the Crossroads on foot (warcraft.wiki.gg Barrens guide, Classic text): from the Durotar tower go south to Razor Hill, then west along the road via Far Watch Post (Kargal Battlescar 62.3, 19.4, Barrens map) crossing into the Barrens, then keep west and take the south branch at the fork to the Crossroads. Alternative: fly Orgrimmar -> Crossroads if the Crossroads flight path is already known (not for a first visit). A new character must first run to the Crossroads and talk to Devrak (51.5, 30.3) to learn the flight path. Quests 840 -> 842 (Takrin Pathseeker in Durotar at 50.8, 43.6 -> Kargal -> Sergra) are the natural breadcrumb on this walk; 840 has minLevel 10.

Crossroads hub (all mapId 1413): flight master Devrak 51.5, 30.3 (games.gg; wowhandbook says 51.5, 30.4); innkeeper Boorand Plainswind 52.0, 29.9 (hearth until level 19-20 per games.gg, then Camp Taurajo innkeeper Byula 45.6, 59.0 or Ratchet); Sergra 52.2, 31.0; Thork 51.5, 30.9; Tonga 52.3, 31.9; Darsok Swiftdagger 51.6, 30.9; Gazrog 51.9, 30.3; Apothecary Helbrim 51.4, 30.1; Regthar Deathgate 45.3, 28.4 (Kolkar watch post, 7 units west); Mankrik 52.0, 31.6; Korran 51.2/29.6 (Egg Hunt, later). Mor'shan Rampart (Kadrak) 48.1, 5.4 is the northern exit; Camp Taurajo flight master 44.5, 59.2 (from level 18); Ratchet flight master Bragok 63.1, 37.2 (boat to Booty Bay).

Level-window caveat: the user's character arrives at about 17. Quests with level below 15 give reduced XP and quests above 20 are not included. games.gg level phases: 10-14 Crossroads/Forgotten Pools/Ratchet, 14-18 North Barrens, Sludge Fen, Stagnant Oasis, 18-22 Camp Taurajo and Wailing Caverns. Wailing Caverns (entrance in Lushwater Oasis, Nalpak and Ebru at 46.0, 35.7) is a Forever dungeon whose XP comes from quests, per project brief; not researched here.

Elite/group warnings from games.gg: Hezrul Bloodmark (852) level 19 or duo at 18; Serena Bloodfeather (876) level 20; Counterattack! (4021) 2-3 players; Free From the Hold (898) escort at 20; The Guns of Northwatch (891) needs escort; The Runed Scroll (3513) group only.

Rare spawns near the route (games.gg): Elder Mystic Razorsnout (15) 59.3, 24.4; Rathorian (15) 48.0, 19.2; Snort the Heckler (17) 41.2, 22.2 near Forgotten Pools; Takk the Leaper (19, rare elite raptor) 59.6, 8.3; Sister Rathtalon (19) 39.1, 15.3 near Serena; Gesharahan (20) 46.5, 39.5.
